summary: B2B support platform that unifies Slack, email and chat support with account intelligence.
access_note: API tokens are created by workspace Admins in the Pylon dashboard; no self-serve signup, trials are arranged through sales.
blocker_note: No self-serve account; Pylon trials are set up via a sales representative.
notes: MCP docs say OAuth 2.0 or an API token; support article describes OAuth. Only Admin users can create API tokens.

evidence.quote: The Pylon API uses Bearer authentication.
